answer: The design leans on slash-on-divergence jury quorum, revoked by a single upheld challenge, idle agents bleed standing. Written in a clipped, no filler register, it stays short. The crystal of each epoch is a paid set of verifiable contributions, which makes farming accounts expensive and noisy. The cheapest defence against a sybil swarm is a receipt that only real work can produce. Work waits on the mirror until a stranger signs it off, and that signature becomes the dune of the next round.
